node_notes.mode_pc8: PC8 selects the driver's three-input PWM mode and is driven low during GPIO configuration and mode selection. The binding is APP_MOTOR_MODE_PIN in app_config.h and the write occurs in motor_platform.c.
node_notes.motor_driver: The portable X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 driver represents the STSPIN830 board interface and accepts three PWM inputs plus standby, mode, and fault callbacks. Its initialization and drive behavior are implemented in firmware/drivers/x_nucleo_ihm16m1/x_nucleo_ihm16m1.c and configured by motor_platform.c.
node_notes.iwdg: The independent watchdog protects the long-running motor sequence and is refreshed during both boot and active control loops. safety_platform.c initializes IWDG with HAL_IWDG_Init and refreshes it through HAL_IWDG_Refresh.
node_notes.fault_pb12: PB12 is the active fault input read by the safety path before enabling and during motor operation. motor_platform.c configures APP_MOTOR_EN_FAULT_PIN with pull-up and reads it using HAL_GPIO_ReadPin.
node_notes.motor: The configured load is the GBM2804H-100T brushless motor driven by the STSPIN830 interface. app_config.h identifies this motor and app.c supplies the sinusoidal U, V, and W duty commands.
node_notes.motor_sequence: This module tracks boot delay, startup ramp, hold, shutdown ramp, and stopped states using elapsed milliseconds. app.c initializes and advances it every APP_MOTOR_CONTROL_PERIOD_MS through motor_sequence_init and motor_sequence_step.
node_notes.tim1_pwm: TIM1 provides the three PWM channels used for U, V, and W at the configured 20 kHz frequency. motor_platform.c initializes TIM1 with a 4000-tick period and maps the channels to PA8, PA9, and PA10 using the configured alternate function.
node_notes.safety_platform: This platform layer initializes the watchdog, reads the motor-driver fault input, latches faults, disables the motor, and refreshes the watchdog. firmware/platforms/stm32/safety_platform.c provides the HAL_IWDG and motor_platform_read_fault calls.
node_notes.sine_control: This module stores phase, frequency, and amplitude and converts them into three sinusoidal duty values. app.c calls sine_control_set_profile, sine_control_output, and sine_control_update, while sine_control.c implements the phase and duty calculations.
node_notes.motor_platform: This STM32 HAL adapter configures the motor GPIOs and TIM1, connects callbacks to the portable X-NUCLEO driver, drives PWM duties, and controls the LED. The evidence is firmware/platforms/stm32/motor_platform.c through HAL_GPIO_*, HAL_TIM_PWM_*, and x_nucleo_ihm16m1_* calls.
node_notes.led_pa5: The NUCLEO-G431RB user LED is driven high during app_start startup. app_config.h binds the active-high LED to PA5, and motor_platform_led_on configures and writes that pin with HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.app_start: This is the one-shot application entry point that sequences LED startup, control initialization, safety setup, motor initialization, and the timed run. The evidence is firmware/app/app.c in app_start, which calls the platform, sequence, sine-control, and safety APIs.
node_notes.stby_pc9: PC9 is the motor-driver standby output and is asserted or released by motor_platform_enable and the driver GPIO callback. app_config.h names it APP_MOTOR_STBY_PIN, and motor_platform.c configures it as a push-pull output.

node_notes.check_initial_fault: Before enabling the driver, the application asks the safety layer to read and latch the motor-driver fault state. app_start calls safety_platform_check_fault, which delegates to motor_platform_read_fault and the X-NUCLEO fault callback.
node_notes.set_profile: The active loop selects startup ramp, constant hold, or shutdown ramp frequency and amplitude from elapsed time. app_set_profile in firmware/app/app.c calls sine_control_set_profile after its real elapsed-time branches.
node_notes.boot_done: This branch represents the app_start condition that ends the boot-delay while loop when sequence.state is no longer MOTOR_SEQUENCE_BOOT_DELAY. The state is maintained by motor_sequence_step in motor_sequence.c.
node_notes.advance_sequence: The timed sequence consumes another 10 ms and eventually transitions through hold and shutdown ramp to stopped. app_start calls motor_sequence_step after each successful control iteration.
node_notes.runtime_fault: The active loop stops immediately when the safety check fails, a latched fault is present, or driving the duty values returns failure. This combined condition is the if statement in app_start surrounding app_drive_sine.
node_notes.stopped: This branch tests motor_sequence_is_stopped to distinguish continued control from normal completion. The helper returns true when the sequence reaches MOTOR_SEQUENCE_STOPPED or is invalid.
node_notes.update_phase: The sine phase advances using the configured 10 ms period and wraps around one electrical cycle. sine_control_update in sine_control.c uses frequency_hz and update_period_ms for this calculation.
node_notes.enable_motor: The normal path starts TIM1 channels one through three and releases driver standby. motor_platform_enable in motor_platform.c performs HAL_TIM_PWM_Start for each channel and writes PC9 low when enabling.
node_notes.init_motor: The motor platform configures the PWM and GPIO interface and initializes the portable STSPIN830 driver in standby. app_start calls motor_platform_init, which configures TIM1, PA8 to PA10, PC8, PC9, and PB12.
node_notes.initial_fault: A failed status or asserted fault prevents PWM enable and causes the application to disable the motor path. The condition is the explicit status or fault test immediately before motor_platform_enable in app_start.
node_notes.init_control: The application creates the initial zeroed sine-control state and boot-delay sequence state. app_start calls sine_control_init and motor_sequence_init before hardware setup.
node_notes.boot_wait: During the configured boot delay, the application refreshes the watchdog and waits for one 10 ms control interval. This is the first while loop in app_start and uses safety_platform_watchdog_refresh plus motor_platform_delay_ms.
node_notes.init_safety: The safety layer clears its latched fault state and initializes the independent watchdog. This step is evidenced by safety_platform_init in firmware/platforms/stm32/safety_platform.c and its HAL_IWDG_Init call.
node_notes.calculate_duty: The sine controller converts the current phase and amplitude into three phase-shifted duty values. sine_control_output in sine_control.c produces duty_u, duty_v, and duty_w for the motor driver.
node_notes.boot_led: The runtime first turns on the board indicator before starting motor control. This is the motor_platform_led_on call at the beginning of firmware/app/app.c:app_start, which drives PA5 high.
node_notes.refresh_runtime: A successful active iteration refreshes the watchdog and delays for the configured control period. These calls occur in the second while loop in firmware/app/app.c:app_start.
node_notes.disable_complete: After a normal sequence completion, app_start also disables PWM and places the driver in standby before logging completion. The call is the final safety_platform_disable in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.boot_step: The sequence state advances by the supplied 10 ms period and changes from boot delay into startup ramp when the configured delay expires. motor_sequence_step in firmware/modules/motor_sequence/motor_sequence.c implements the elapsed-time thresholds.
node_notes.drive_motor: The computed duty values are passed through the platform adapter to the portable driver. app_drive_sine calls motor_platform_drive, which invokes x_nucleo_ihm16m1_drive_motor and updates TIM1 compare values.
node_notes.disable_fault: The fault path latches the safety fault and disables the motor by stopping PWM and asserting standby. safety_platform_disable calls motor_platform_enable(false), which stops TIM1 channels and writes PC9 high.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot
  participant App as app_start
  participant Sequence as motor_sequence
  participant Safety as safety_platform
  participant Platform as motor_platform
  participant Sine as sine_control
  participant Driver as STSPIN830
  participant Watchdog as IWDG
  Boot->>App: Call app_start after HAL and clock setup
  App->>Platform: motor_platform_led_on
  App->>Sine: sine_control_init
  App->>Sequence: motor_sequence_init
  App->>Safety: safety_platform_init
  Safety->>Watchdog: HAL_IWDG_Init
  App->>Platform: motor_platform_init
  Platform->>Driver: x_nucleo_ihm16m1_init
  loop Every 10 ms during boot delay
    App->>Safety: safety_platform_watchdog_refresh
    Safety->>Watchdog: HAL_IWDG_Refresh
    App->>Platform: motor_platform_delay_ms
    App->>Sequence: motor_sequence_step
  end
  App->>Safety: safety_platform_check_fault
  Safety->>Driver: x_nucleo_ihm16m1_read_fault
  alt Initial fault or status failure
    App->>Safety: safety_platform_disable
    Safety->>Platform: motor_platform_enable false
    Platform->>Driver: Stop PWM and assert standby
  else No initial fault
    App->>Platform: motor_platform_enable true
    Platform->>Driver: Start TIM1 PWM and release standby
    loop Every 10 ms until sequence stops
      App->>Safety: safety_platform_check_fault
      Safety->>Driver: Read EN_FAULT on PB12
      App->>Sine: sine_control_set_profile
      App->>Sine: sine_control_output
      App->>Platform: motor_platform_drive duty U V W
      Platform->>Driver: x_nucleo_ihm16m1_drive_motor
      alt Fault or drive failure
        App->>Safety: safety_platform_disable
        Safety->>Platform: motor_platform_enable false
      else Drive accepted
        App->>Sine: sine_control_update 10 ms
        App->>Safety: safety_platform_watchdog_refresh
        App->>Platform: motor_platform_delay_ms 10 ms
        App->>Sequence: motor_sequence_step
      end
    end
    App->>Safety: safety_platform_disable
    Safety->>Platform: motor_platform_enable false
  end
